emails.subject: URGENT: Data Query - Missing PK Sample Collection Times - Study SP-2024-301
emails.body:
Hi David,

We've identified critical data discrepancies during our routine data review for Study SP-2024-301. Three participants at Metro Research Site (Site 1047) are missing exact PK sample collection times:

Participant ID: 1047-003 - Visit 3 (Day 15)
Participant ID: 1047-007 - Visit 3 (Day 15) 
Participant ID: 1047-012 - Visit 2 (Day 8)

The eCRF shows PK samples were collected, but the exact collection times are blank. This is critical for our PK analysis as we need precise timing relative to dose administration.

Can you please escalate this to the site? We may need a source document verification visit to pull the exact times from their source records. This is holding up our PK dataset lock.

Thanks,
Jennifer

- Participant 1047-012: I'm still locating the complete documentation for this visit. Our phlebotomist's log shows the sample was collected but the exact time notation is unclear. I'm checking with our nursing staff who were present.

I'm copying Dr. Patel, our PI, for awareness.

For 1047-003 and 1047-007, I can update the eCRF today. For 1047-012, I should have clarity by end of day Monday. Would Lisa be able to come onsite Tuesday or Wednesday next week to verify all three if needed? That would ensure everything is properly documented.

I apologize for this oversight and will be implementing additional QC checks on our PK data entry going forward.

Sarah

emails.subject: Site Visit Report - Metro Research Site - PK Data Query Resolution
emails.body:
Hi David and Jennifer,

I completed the source document verification visit at Metro Research Site today. Here's my report:

SUMMARY:
All three missing PK sample collection times have been verified and corrected in the eCRF. Source documentation supports all entries.

FINDINGS:

Participant 1047-003 (Visit 3, Day 15):
- Source: Lab collection log dated 02/28/2024
- Collection times verified: Pre-dose (08:15), 1hr (09:20), 2hr (10:18), 4hr (12:22), 8hr (16:19)
- eCRF now matches source ✓

Participant 1047-007 (Visit 3, Day 15):
- Source: Lab collection log dated 03/05/2024  
- Collection times verified: Pre-dose (09:02), 1hr (10:05), 2hr (11:04), 4hr (13:08), 8hr (17:06)
- eCRF now matches source ✓

Participant 1047-012 (Visit 2, Day 8):
- Source: Pharmacy dispensing log cross-referenced with nursing notes dated 02/22/2024
- Collection times verified: Pre-dose (07:45), 1hr (08:48), 2hr (09:46), 4hr (11:52), 8hr (15:48)
- eCRF now matches source ✓

ROOT CAUSE:
The site's phlebotomist was recording times in the lab log but the study coordinator was not consistently transcribing all timepoints to the eCRF during initial data entry. This was an isolated incident affecting only these three visits.

CORRECTIVE ACTIONS (implemented by site):
1. Revised data entry checklist to include PK time verification step
2. Weekly PK data completeness review before eCRF page completion
3. Phlebotomist now initials eCRF PK page after coordinator entry to confirm accuracy

RECOMMENDATION:
No further action needed. Issue resolved. Site has implemented appropriate preventive measures.

Jennifer - all corrected data is now available for your PK analysis.

Please let me know if you need any additional information.

Best regards,
Lisa

---
Lisa Chen, PhD
Clinical Research Associate
Sponsor Pharma Inc.
